span.p: WHY ONE STRUCTURE IS THE WRONG OUTPUT

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Riboswitches are DEFINED by holding two folds
apo (unbound) and holo (ligand-bound).
Predicting one predicts half the biology.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
The field has moved off the minimum-free-energy structure:
functional RNAs are heterogeneous ensembles where the
most stable state may be a MINOR subpopulation.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
CASP16 now scores alternative conformations
as its own track.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
103,964 annotated base-pair steps, 155/180 structures
F = kT C^-1 for 76 contexts with n >= 200
twist force constants span 115x
UG/UG 1.343e-2 (stiff) to AA/UA 1.167e-4 (floppy)

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
46,447 RNA unobserved-residue records
(143,871 raw rows, but 67.5 pct are protein)
a residue too mobile to model IS a disorder label.
Free, in every deposited structure,
used by NO RNA structure predictor.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
HEADROOM - negative log-likelihood, lower better
M0 global 19.72
M1 sequence context 17.58 (gain 2.14)
M_struct structure only 17.85 (gain 1.88)
M2 sequence x structure 14.55 (gain 3.03 over sequence)

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
STIFFNESS ENCODER
reads the PAIR REPRESENTATION over a neighbourhood,
not a 16-entry dinucleotide lookup table.
Justified by M3: structural context adds MORE
than sequence context (3.03 vs 2.14 nats).

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ASSEMBLE F over the chain
-> diagonalise -> low-frequency normal modes
NO sampling, NO molecular dynamics

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
K = 3 alternative states + weights
gRNAde: 3-5 pct gain, best at 3 states
RNAnneal uses 10

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
WHAT THIS DOES NOT CLAIM
This is an EQUILIBRIUM FLUCTUATION model.
It describes breathing AROUND a fold.
It is NOT a folding-pathway predictor.
Cotranscriptional folding is KINETIC - structure evolves
as the chain elongates and rarely equilibrates, so
cotranscriptional products deviate from thermodynamics.
Reconstructing pathways needs TIME-RESOLVED probing data
(the R2D2 approach), which is in neither our catalogue
nor Ribonanza.
Supportable claim: predicts the fold, its local rigidity,
its disorder, and the amplitude of motion about it,
under stated ionic conditions.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
RISK R7 - ENSEMBLE EVALUATION IS BARELY DEFINED
No settled metric for scoring a predicted RNA ensemble.
RNAnneal compares against just 16 experimentally-resolved
riboswitch conformations. Reporting '3 states' without a
protocol agreed in advance would be uninterpretable.
Single-state TM-score on blind sets stays the headline.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
CAVEAT ON THE STIFFNESS ITSELF
3 of 76 contexts have covariance condition number > 1e4
(AU/AA, GA/AA, GC/AC) - F = kT C^-1 is least reliable
exactly where the steps are floppiest.
